plan.notes: Official 2026-2027 Major Map (recommended sequence) for the B.S. in Exercise Science, Arnold School of Public Health, Dept. of Exercise Science, from the USC Major Map Repository (2026_exsc_map.pdf). All 8 semesters transcribed; semester sums verified against printed totals (16/17/14/17/16/15/13/12 at slot minimums = 120, matches Graduation Requirements Summary: 120 total, 25 major, 51-63 college/program, 32-44 Carolina Core, 2.000 GPA). Semester One printed '15-16' with fixed courses summing to 16. Ranged slots transcribed at minimums with notes: Foreign language/other Carolina Core (3-4) at 3. Two cognates required: a general 12-credit-hour cognate (300+, advisor-approved) and a 12-credit-hour EXSC cognate (300+, EXSC major courses excluded); foreign language proficiency equivalent to the 110 course required. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
